unit: (topic, work): every record either phrasing of the topic returned in A3, both sources, merged by dedup.works (dedup-rules-1, SHIPPED_RULE T=0.85 Y=2); members name records by source and source_id.
judged: Every work, not a top-k pool. Blind: the sheet showed both topic phrasings, the work's title and the first 500 characters of its abstract, in a seeded shuffle (stream 'D149/<topic>'), and no source, rank, year, venue or citation count.
guideline:
# D149 judging guideline (written 2026-10-08, before any sheet was opened)

The question for every paper: **would someone researching this topic, as both phrasings state
it, want this paper in their reading list?** Judged on the title and abstract only. Source,
rank, year, venue and citation count are not shown and must not be looked up.

- **2 - on topic.** The paper's main contribution (a method, an analysis, a benchmark, a survey,
  a negative result) is about the topic as stated.
- **1 - partly on topic.** It addresses one component of the topic, or the topic is a substantial
  but secondary part of it: the topic's technique applied as the central tool to another problem,
  a broader survey that covers the topic, a closely adjacent technique positioned against it.
- **0 - off topic.** It shares words but not the subject, mentions the topic in passing, or uses
  the topic's terms in another sense.
- **unsure** is recorded beside the grade (the grade is still given); the owner reviews every one.
- **No abstract:** judged on the title, and flagged.

Per-topic scope, fixed now so that borderline calls are consistent within a topic:

| Topic | 2 | 1, not 2 |
|---|---|---|
| t01 RAG over long documents | retrieval-augmented generation that targets long inputs: chunking, long-context RAG, retrieval vs long context | RAG in general with no long-document focus; long-context LLMs without retrieval |
| t02 low-rank adaptation of LLMs | LoRA and its variants (QLoRA, AdaLoRA, ...), analyses of them, for language models | other parameter-efficient fine-tuning (adapters, prompt tuning) positioned against LoRA; LoRA for non-language models |
| t03 dense retrieval for open-domain QA | dense (learned-embedding) retrievers evaluated on or built for open-domain QA | sparse or hybrid retrieval for ODQA; dense retrieval for other tasks; ODQA readers |
| t04 hallucination detection in LLMs | detecting or measuring hallucination / factual errors in LM output | hallucination mitigation without a detection component; surveys of hallucination as a whole |
| t05 state space models for long sequences | SSM architectures (S4, Mamba, ...) and analyses of them for long sequences, incl. versus attention | SSMs applied to a domain task as the central tool; efficient attention positioned against SSMs |
| t06 GNNs for molecular property prediction | graph neural networks predicting molecular or materials properties | GNNs for other molecular tasks (generation, docking); non-GNN property predictors positioned against GNNs |
| t07 knowledge distillation for compression | distillation methods or analyses whose aim is a smaller or cheaper model | compression without distillation (pruning, quantization) positioned with it; distillation for aims other than compression |
| t08 diffusion models for image generation | denoising diffusion models generating images (incl. conditional, inpainting, latent) | diffusion for non-image data; image tasks that use diffusion for something other than generation (e.g. denoising a measurement) |
| t09 contrastive learning of sentence embeddings | contrastive objectives for training sentence/text embeddings | sentence embeddings without a contrastive objective; contrastive learning for other modalities |
| t10 chain-of-thought prompting and reasoning | eliciting, improving or analysing step-by-step reasoning in LMs by prompting | reasoning in LMs by other means (fine-tuning on rationales, search) positioned with CoT; CoT in a narrow application as the central tool |
split: odd-numbered topics train (weights are fitted there), even-numbered topics are held out (scores are reported there), as D146.
